items.title: Brian Moynihan Says Investment-Banking Revenue Is Down at BofA
items.summary: Bank of America Chief Executive Brian Moynihan said Monday that investment-banking revenue would fall by 10% in the quarter from a year earlier.  “We're not as well positioned in some of the businesses that … had more activity,” Moynihan said at a financial conference hosted by Barclays.
